title: NASA-UAP-D018, Gemini 4 Experiment Debriefing, 1967
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of the Gemini IV experiment debriefing held in 1967, detailing astronaut observations of particles and other phenomena in orbit. / This document is a collection of NASA Gemini mission debriefing transcripts and related correspondence regarding scientific experiments, including observations of meteors, planets, and missile tracking.

incidents.summary: Astronauts McDivitt and White observed bright particles outside the Gemini IV spacecraft.
incidents.quote: You see a crystal or two go by very once in a while.

incidents.summary: Astronauts Cooper and Conrad tracked a Minuteman ICBM launched from Vandenberg AFB while in orbit.
incidents.quote: I see it, I see it!

incidents.summary: Astronauts Cooper and Conrad tracked a second Minuteman ICBM launch from Vandenberg AFB.
incidents.quote: they watched a second Minuteman missile launch
